items.headline: Amazon Prime Day total online spending surpasses Adobe estimate
items.summary: Total spending for the period was up 9.3% from last year’s Prime Day sale held in July, according to Adobe.

items.headline: Why investors may want to prioritize bond markets outside the U.S.

items.headline: 1 Reason Why Passively Managed Index Funds Could Save You More Money Than Mutual Funds

items.headline: American couple left New York City and bought a house in Italy for $13,000: 'We found a different way of life'
items.summary: Cassandra Tresl and Alex Ninman moved in with Tresl's grandfather in the Czech Republic in 2020 and closed on a house in Abruzzo, Italy, in 2022.
